name: kario-studio
description: Build, run, debug, test, package and publish Kario TypeScript apps (KarioUI) from VS Code or Cursor

kario.cli.description: The kario command (kario build in the Kario tree: build/bin/kario).

kario.shell.description: phone-shell (empty: kario finds it beside itself or on PATH).

kario.renderer.description: The pixel renderer of the preview panel (empty: kario finds phone-paint).

kario.node.description: Node.js 22.15 or newer (empty: node on PATH).

kario.device.description: The form factor the app runs on.

kario.previewAddress.description: Where the preview's page is served.

kario.signing.devStore.description: Sign packages with a development store kept in this directory (developer mode).

kario.signing.key.description: The developer's signing key (phone-pkg keygen), relative to the project.

kario.signing.cert.description: The developer's certificate from the store (phone-pkg register), relative to the project.

kario.storeUrl.description: The store backend packages are submitted to (POST /v1/submissions).

kario.rollout.description: An update goes to this percentage of devices first.

kario.reloadOnSave.description: In the preview panel and when debugging, build the app again when a source is saved and restart it on its pages (kario run -watch).
